messages:
Priya N: posting follow-up from today's RFC review — small operational proposal for presets + a shadow-sampler and per-tenant override flow. want quick sanity check.

Derek M: high level pls

Priya N: plan: assign a precision preset per workload class (interactive, embeddings, batch, rerank). add a 1% shadow-sampler that mirrors traffic to higher-precision path and diffs outputs. use shadow diffs to tune deg thresholds before automatic fallbacks.

Luis V: shadow-sampler = great. how do we store diffs without blowing up storage?

Priya N: keep diffs ephemeral: store hashed anchors + small summary metrics (cosine delta for embeddings, BLEU/degscore for nlg, token-error-rate for structured). only persist full examples on significant samples flagged by anomaly detector.

Ellen S: for embeddings we must treat defaults as quality-first. tiny drift -> broken nearest-neighbor. lower degscore threshold for embeddings (0.04 vs 0.12 for text gen).

Nikhil R: runtime checklist: compatibility matrix for KV cache & kernel. if kv_format mismatch -> cannot switch in-place. need fast path: route to compatible pod or remote pool.

Derek M: agree. also add an API on the runtime to query "can_switch(model, variant)" so ops/UI can show expected latency/cost before applying override.

Priya N: good call. add schema below.

```
precision_presets:
  interactive: balanced
  embeddings: quality-first
  batch: cost-first
overrides:
  per_endpoint_allowed: true
  approval_needed_for_high_cost: true
shadow_sampler:
  sample_rate: 0.01
  persist_threshold: 0.005  # top 0.5% diffs persist
compatibility_checks:
  kv_format_compatible: true
  kernel_abi_compatible: true
telemetry_thresholds:
  gen_degscore: 0.12
  embeddings_degscore: 0.04
  token_error_rate: 0.02
```

Luis V: ops question: when fallback hops to remote pool, will we account cost to tenant immediately? We need per-shard cost accounting so billing team can look at surprises.

Ellen S: add a per-tenant budget guard that can block automated fallback if projected cost > X% of monthly spend. fallback can instead trigger an alert for manual review.

Priya N: yes. default behavior: auto-fallback up to a soft budget delta (5% over normal spend), beyond that raise alert and pause. we'll make it configurable per-tenant.

Nikhil R: ops-bot: create placeholder alert rule for embeddings degscore > 0.04 over 3x 5m windows for prod customer-facing endpoints.

ops-bot: created ML-EMB-DEG-1780 -> condition: prod && customer_facing && 3 consecutive 5m windows embeddings_degscore > 0.04. Notifies: #eng-ml-oncall + pager.

Derek M: one more: can we add a lightweight dashboard column: shadow-delta-rate, fallback-count, manual-overrides? helps triage.

Priya N: will ask analytics to add tiles. action items: 1) compatibility matrix schema PR 2) shadow sampler impl + ephemeral diffs 3) budget-guard + per-tenant cap 4) runtime switch API + UI surface 5) dashboard + alerts. i'll open PRs and tag owners.

Ellen S: thanks — will sync with pricing and infra on cold-start costs.

Luis V: +1, thanks.

Priya N: thanks all, PRs incoming.
